39799985.q: I'm pregnant and I smoke. Should I join a scheme that pays me incentives to quit?
39799985.sentence: high-certainty evidence that incentive schemes conducted amongst pregnant people who smoke improve smoking cessation rates

32628791.q: I tested positive for H. pylori but have no symptoms. Should I take treatment to clear it to lower my stomach cancer risk?
32628791.sentence: moderate certainty evidence that searching for and eradicating H. pylori reduces the incidence of gastric cancer

32356360.q: I have a bad sore throat and I'm on antibiotics. Should I also take a single dose of corticosteroid for the pain?
32356360.sentence: Oral or intramuscular corticosteroids, in addition to antibiotics, moderately increased the likelihood of both resolution and improvement of pain

31638271.q: I want to quit smoking. Should I sign up for an automated text message program to help me?
31638271.sentence: moderate-certainty evidence that automated text message-based smoking cessation interventions result in greater quit rates

31045250.q: I want to quit smoking. Should I call a quitline for telephone counselling?
31045250.sentence: moderate-certainty evidence that proactive telephone counselling increases quit rates

31166007.q: I'm using nicotine patches to quit smoking. Should I also get behavioural support sessions?
31166007.sentence: high-certainty evidence that providing behavioural support in person or via telephone for people using pharmacotherapy to stop smoking increases quit rates

30829399.q: Should my family use fluoride toothpaste instead of non-fluoride toothpaste?
30829399.sentence: This Cochrane Review supports the benefits of using fluoride toothpaste in preventing caries when compared to non-fluoride toothpaste

35420698.q: I have diabetes and gum disease. Should I get deep cleaning treatment for my gums to help my blood sugar?
35420698.sentence: moderate-certainty evidence that periodontal treatment using subgingival instrumentation improves glycaemic control

39880377.q: I've been diagnosed with generalised anxiety disorder. Should I take an antidepressant for it?
39880377.sentence: We are highly confident in this evidence

30707445.q: I have shoulder pain from rotator cuff disease. Should I have subacromial decompression surgery?
30707445.sentence: there was probably no clinically important benefit in this outcome either compared with placebo, exercises or non-operative treatment

30699470.q: I'm 45 and healthy. Should I go for a general health check every year to lower my risk of dying from disease?
30699470.sentence: Health checks have little or no effect on fatal and non-fatal ischaemic heart disease
